name: Iron Pyre
look: a lean robot Moltres with a gold egg body, a ringed silver neck, a long silver beak and red grid visor, segmented gold wing arms hung with jagged glowing flame and a tail of fire
entry: A Pokémon resembling Moltres, pictured in a dubious science magazine beside a story of a furnace that learned to fly. Its wings are hung with sheets of living flame, and its visor glows red as it hunts by heat.
how: Wild: very rare in the Nether.
